introduction.text: The Helix is a planetary nebula about 216 parsecs away. Its broad ring of glowing gas surrounds the remnant central star.

distance.method: Adopted published trigonometric parallax; not a fitted image scale.

classification.name: Planetary nebula
classification.basis: Source-colored relative emission fitted to aligned ESO images with a molecular-velocity scaffold where measured. Unsupported depth and the front/back assignment remain conditional. Compact lights have observed image positions, with illustrative field depths.
